stem: Meera looks out of the window of her home in Delhi. It is morning and the Sun is shining. Her pen-friend Arjun, who lives on the opposite side of the Earth, says it is night where he is. Why do day and night occur at a place on Earth?

options.text: The Sun moves around the Earth once every day.
The Earth rotates on its axis, moving each place into and out of the side facing the Sun.
The Earth moves around the Sun once every year.
The Moon blocks the Sun's light every night.

teacher.key_rationale: Day and night are caused by Earth's rotation on its axis: as Earth spins, each place turns to face the Sun (day) and then away from it (night). Option A is the Sun-moves trap, C conflates the yearly orbit with the daily cycle, and D confuses night with an eclipse. Key B.
